LOTTERIES ACT 1952

LOTTERIES (REGISTRATION AND LICENSING OF GAMING MACHINES)

(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2012

IN excercise of the powers conferred by section 14 of the Lotteries Act 1952 [Act 288],

the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Lotteries (Registration and

Licensing of Gaming Machines) (Amendment) Regulations 2012.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 October 2012.

Amendment of First Schedule

2. The Lotteries (Registration and Licensing of Gaming Machines) Regulations 1973

[P.U. (A) 161/1973] is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the following

Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

(Regulation 14)

Item No. Particulars Fee

(RM)

1. Registration, processing and transfer

fee per gaming machine

100.00

2. Fee for the permit to operate gaming

machines per annum

5000.00

3. Dealer's license fee per annum 10000.00

4. Duplicate permit or licence fee 100.00

5. Deposit to operate a gaming machine 4000.00".

Made 28 September 2012

[KK/BP/WAII(S)10/173/390]; PN(PU2)225]

 On behalf and in the name of Minister of Finance

DATO' IR. DONALD LIM SIANG CHAI

Deputy Minister of Finance
